 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

The petitioners, vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, seek quashing of FIR No.0319/2020 dated 05.12.2020 registered under Section(s)
498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Pahar Ganj, Central District, Delhi and all proceedings emanating therefrom, in view of the fact that the parties have settled all their disputes amicably and are now living together.

2. This petition is supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3. Petitioner nos. 1 to 4 and as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
CRL.M.C. 9185/2023 page 1 of 2

Issue Notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
Since, this a matrimonial dispute, he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
6. Respondent no.2 confirms that she has voluntarily settled all her disputes with the petitioners, of her own accord without any duress, coercion or pressure.

She further states that she does not wish to pursue the criminal proceedings against the petitioners and has no objection to the quashing of Sanjay & Ors vs The State (Govt Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr on 14 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52192077/

7. In view of the fact that the disputes arise out of matrimonial discord and settlement has been arrived at between the parties, and as the respondent no.2 does not wish to continue with the criminal proceedings, in order to bring a quietus to the present disputes and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jitendra Raghuvanshi & Ors.

Vs. Babita Raguvanshi & Anr (2013) 4 SCC 58, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh &
Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2014) 6 SCC 466, this Court is of the opinion that continuation of the aforesaid FIR will be an exercise in futility.

sentences.text:
8. Accordingly, the present petition is allowed and FIR No.0319/2020 dated 05.12.2020 registered under Section(s) 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Pahar Ganj, Central District,
Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom are quashed.
9. Accordingly, the present petition, alongwith the pending application, if any, stands disposed of.
